title: tc-active-days
description:
A month calendar of rings, each day filled to how much of its goal it met – with the month's goal days, best
streak and busiest weekday, and the day's value on hover or focus.

heading.description: The heading, and the grid's name

days.description: The days with activity, "YYYY-MM-DD", in any order; a day not listed has no data

goal.description: The daily goal: a day at or over it is a full ring

month.description: The month in view first, "YYYY-MM"; by default the latest month in `days`

now.description: Today, as epoch ms – days after it are blank; by default the clock

weekStart.description: The first day of the week: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday … 6 Saturday

unit.description: What the values count, after the number: "12 reviews"

date.description: The selected day, "YYYY-MM-DD". Changed by the user unless a tc-date-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for month, weekday and number names, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

value.description: How much happened; null means no data for the day
